params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Rumble}} {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts generate {{tip|Heat}}, which gradually expires after a few seconds without generating Heat. Rumble enters the ''Danger Zone'' while he has at least {{tip|Heat|50 Heat}}, and becomes ''Overheated'' at {{tip|Heat|Max Heat}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|[[File:Junkyard Titan 2.png|24px]] Danger Zone:}} '''Rumble's''' basic abilities are empowered.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|[[File:Junkyard Titan 3.png|24px]] Overheated:}} '''Rumble's''' abilities are disabled as his {{tip|Heat}} decays over a few seconds. During this time, his basic attacks gain {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rumble's''' {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts generate {{tip|Heat}}, which decays by {{tip|Heat|10 Heat}} per second after not using any basic ability within 4 seconds or ''{{ai|The Equalizer|Rumble}}'' within 2 seconds. '''Rumble's''' mech enters the ''Danger Zone'' when at or above {{tip|Heat|50 Heat}}, and becomes ''Overheated'' while at {{tip|Heat|150 Heat}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Danger Zone:}} '''Rumble's''' mech enters the ''Danger Zone'', empowering his basic abilities.
params.description3: {{sbc|Overheated:}} '''Rumble's''' mech becomes ''Overheated'', disabling his {{tip|abilities}} as his {{tip|Heat}} decays back down to 0 over 4 seconds. During this time, he gains {{sti|{{as|{{pp|30+((100-30)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and empowers his {{tip|basic attacks}} to deal {{pp|5 + (40-5)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{pp|90+((175-90)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.notes:
* While '''Rumble''' is ''overheating'', a [[File: Silence icon.png|20px]] ''Silenced'' icon will appear above him to signify he cannot cast {{tip|abilities}}. This is visible to all units.
* The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against {{tip|structures}}.

blurb.plain: Innate: Rumble basic ability casts generate Heat, which gradually expires after a few seconds without generating Heat. Rumble enters the Danger Zone while he has at least 50 Heat, and becomes Overheated at Max Heat.

blurb2.plain: Danger Zone: Rumble's basic abilities are empowered.

blurb3.plain: Overheated: Rumble's abilities are disabled as his Heat decays over a few seconds. During this time, his basic attacks gain bonus attack speed and deal bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health.

description.plain: Innate: Rumble's basic ability casts generate Heat, which decays by 10 Heat per second after not using any basic ability within 4 seconds or The Equalizer within 2 seconds. Rumble's mech enters the Danger Zone when at or above 50 Heat, and becomes Overheated while at 150 Heat.

description2.plain: Danger Zone: Rumble's mech enters the Danger Zone, empowering his basic abilities.

description3.plain: Overheated: Rumble's mech becomes Overheated, disabling his abilities as his Heat decays back down to 0 over 4 seconds. During this time, he gains ⟦pp⟧ bonus attack speed and empowers his basic attacks to deal ⟦pp⟧ (+ 25% AP) (+ 4% of the target's maximum health) bonus magic damage on-hit. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at ⟦pp⟧ against monsters.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rumble}} activates a flamethrower for a short time that continually deals {{as|magic damage}} in a frontal cone.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Flamespitter's'' damage is increased.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' generates {{tip|Heat|20 Heat}} to activate his flamethrower for 3 seconds, spewing forth flames in a {{tt|frontal|In his facing direction}} cone every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. Enemies hit by the flame are scorched for {{ap|0.5 + 0.1}} seconds, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds as well as upon being hit if not currently scorched, refreshing on subsequent inflictions.

''Flamespitter's'' damage is reduced to {{ap|0.7*100}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
params.description2:
{{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Flamespitter's'' damage is increased by 50%.

''Flamespitter's'' total damage based on the target's health is capped at {{pp|65+((300-65)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|formula=Uses stat growth interpolation; 65 base, 300 maximum}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|600|Cone length}}|{{tt|-50|Cone origin point behind Rumble's center}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Flamespitter'' will deal an additional tick of damage to a minion if it would die to its per-tick damage. This is intended.
* '''Rumble''' will instantly turn to face the cursor if he is not moving when ''Flamespitter'' is cast. He will also instantly turn when issuing an Attack order on an enemy while ''Flamespitter'' is active.
** Issuing an Attack Move order at a location will not cause '''Rumble''' to instantly turn.{{bug|2}}
** If '''Rumble''' does not path to a location after an Attack or Attack Move order, and the player issues a Stop or Hold order immediately afterwards, '''Rumble''' will not visually turn completely to face the new direction,{{bug}} but the area will turn to have the correct direction as intended.
* When ''Flamespitter's'' debuff is applied instead of refreshed, the target is dealt one additional instance of the debuff at the same time as the application. This is done by delaying the actual debuff by {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
** If the target is already affected by the debuff, its duration is refreshed to the maximum ({{fd|0.6}} seconds).

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rumble}} briefly {{tip|shields}} himself and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Scrap Shield's'' effects are increased.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' generates {{tip|Heat|20 Heat}} to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description2: '''Rumble''' also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{tt|1 to {{fd|1.32}} seconds.|See notes}}
params.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Scrap Shield's'' shield strength and {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} are increased in effectiveness by 50%.
params.leveling3:
{{st|Enhanced Shield Strength|{{ap|25*1.5 to 145*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*1.5}}% of '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Enhanced Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10*1.5 to 30*1.5}}%}}
params.notes:
* The movement speed buff is supposed to last for 1 second, but due to a bug may last {{rutngt|0.25}} longer.
** Like most buffs, the stat bonus is already only gained at the next stat update (every {{rutngt|0.25}}). Despite this, the duration still inconsistent.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rumble}} shoots a harpoon in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow|slows}} the first enemy hit, reducing their {{sti|mpen|{{as|magic resist}}}} for a few seconds. These effects can stack with multiple harpoons.
params.blurb2: '''Rumble''' periodically [[stocks]] an ''Electro Harpoon'', up to a cap.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Electro Harpoon's'' effects are increased.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' generates {{tip|Heat|20 Heat}} to shoot a harpoon in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, inflicting them with {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance reduction}}}} for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. These effects {{tip|stacks additively|stack additively}} with multiple harpoons, refreshing their duration and stacking up to 2 times.
params.description2: '''Rumble''' periodically [[stocks]] an ''Electro Harpoon'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
params.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Electro Harpoon's'' effects are increased by 50%.
params.description4: ''If '''Rumble''' casts Electro Harpoon before his mech becomes {{ai|Junkyard Titan 3|Rumble|Overheated}}, he may still use another charge within 3 seconds of the initial cast.''

These effects stack additively with multiple harpoons, refreshing their duration and stacking up to 2 times.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rumble}} deploys a barrage of rockets along the target path that create a field which lingers for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: Enemies within the area are continually dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' deploys a barrage of rockets from the sky along the target path in a line over {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Each rocket impacts the ground to create a field of fire that lasts {{fd|4.5}} seconds.
params.description2: Enemies struck by the impact or within the field are marked ''Burning'' for 1 second, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds and being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 35%, refreshing while in the area. Enemies may be ''Burning'' for up to 5 seconds, for a total of 20 instances of its effect.
params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|120/4 to 280/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35/4}}% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|120 to 280}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35}}% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|120*5 to 280*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*5}}% AP)}}}}
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|-175|Damage range behind vector origin}}| {{tt|1135|Maximum damage range forward, estimated}}}}
params.width: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|410 - {{fd|368.4}}|Widest and thinnest point of the chain of circles, respectively}}
params.notes:
* ''The Equalizer's'' cumulative hitbox consists of a row of six rockets, each having a circular area of effect with a radius of 205 units. Each rocket drops at an offset of 180 units from the previous in the vector of cast.
** The missile that manages the rockets being deployed starts 150 units behind the target vector origin, and thus drops the first rocket at 30 units in front of the cast vector origin, which is equivalent to a period of {{rutngt|0.1125}} from the cast point.
* A given field checks for targets to apply or refresh the debuff on once every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
* Due to each field expiring at different points in time, champions moving in the duration of the rockets' launch as they are expiring may sometimes receive 1 more instance of the debuff at most beyond the maximum.{{bug}}
